description: TPLDetect: Thermography-based Pipeline Leak Detection is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Elena Vollmer (Karlsruhe Institute of Technology). This release contains the version of the TPLDetect (Thermography-based Pipeline Leak Detection) software accompanying the PhD dissertation by E. Vollmer titled "Towards Automatic Thermography-Based Leak Detection in District Heating Systems". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
